q64_exposure.method: git archive <rev> frontend/src, then --tree on that snapshot

instrument_defects_named_in_this_deliver: r5 was minted with `git cherry-pick 279f1fcd~4..279f1fcd`, and A~4..A excludes A~4 -- the product commit was left out, so refs/heads/review/newlane-ord0444-collections-r5 carries review files only.
the first probe URL was built without substituting the port, so every call raised InvalidURL and my wait loop read it as 'the server is down'.
the store was read through a filename the server was not given, and a leftover .db-wal replayed three shelves from earlier runs of this same probe.
